name: Diable Pod
desc: An explosive wreathed in a noxious purple aura. When detonated, it unleashes a dangerous force that has adverse effects on the body.

eff.name: Binding Blast
eff.desc1: Deals bolt damage and lowers Negative Effect resistance.
eff.desc2: Deals bolt damage. Damage is increased for each negative effect the target has.

eff.name: Sealed Evil Strike
eff.desc1: Has a [Lv. x 10]% chance to apply 1 random negative effect(s) to the target.

eff.name: Extended Negative Effect Duration
eff.desc1: Extends the duration of target's negative effects by [Lv. x 3] seconds.
